```{r r-export}
#| include: false
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CLUS_COL   <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
N_PCA_DIMS <- 30L
OUT_DIR    <- "/tmp/paga_hsc"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                ~ x
  )
}

# ── Load full-cohort object (source of cluster labels + background UMAP) ──────
cat("Loading mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc ...\n")
mpn_full <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

full_umap_raw  <- as.data.frame(mpn_full@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
clus_meta_full <- data.frame(
  cluster   = as.character(mpn_full@meta.data[[CLUS_COL]]),
  row.names = colnames(mpn_full)
)

# Save full-cohort UMAP as grey background reference for all condition plots
write.csv(full_umap_raw, file.path(OUT_DIR, "bg_umap.csv"))

cat(sprintf("Full cohort: %d cells, %d clusters\n",
            nrow(clus_meta_full), length(unique(clus_meta_full$cluster))))

rm(mpn_full); invisible(gc())

# ── Helper: export one condition-specific object ──────────────────────────────
export_condition <- function(target_name, name) {
  cat(sprintf("Loading %s ...\n", target_name))
  srt <- targets::tar_read_raw(target_name)

  shared <- intersect(colnames(srt), rownames(clus_meta_full))
  obs <- data.frame(
    cluster   = clus_meta_full[shared, "cluster"],
    condition = label_condition(srt$sample.name[shared]),
    sample    = srt$sample.name[shared],
    row.names = shared
  )
  pca  <- as.data.frame(
    Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "pca.SCT")[shared, seq_len(N_PCA_DIMS)])
  umap_own  <- as.data.frame(srt@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[shared, ])
  umap_full <- full_umap_raw[shared, ]

  write.csv(obs,       file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, "_obs.csv")))
  write.csv(pca,       file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, "_pca.csv")))
  write.csv(umap_own,  file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, "_umap.csv")))
  write.csv(umap_full, file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, "_umap_full.csv")))

  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells, clusters: %s\n",
              name, nrow(obs), paste(sort(unique(obs$cluster)), collapse = " ")))
  rm(srt, pca, umap_own, umap_full); invisible(gc())
}

export_condition("mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc",    "wt")
export_condition("mpn_processed_hsc_mchneg_fullcc", "mchneg")
export_condition("mpn_processed_hsc_mchpos_fullcc", "mchpos")

cat("Data export complete →", OUT_DIR, "\n")
```

```{python py-setup}
import sys, os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import seaborn as sns
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad

sc.settings.verbosity = 1
DATA_DIR  = "/tmp/paga_hsc"
N_NEIGH   = 20    # kNN neighbours (matches Seurat k_neighbors)
CLUS_COL  = "cluster"
THRESHOLD        = 0.15  # minimum PAGA connectivity weight to draw an edge
EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS = ["16", "17", "20"]

cond_pal = {"WT": "#888888", "mCh-": "#2a9d8f", "mCh+": "#e76f51"}
```

```{python py-helpers}
def load_adata(name, data_dir=DATA_DIR):
    """Assemble AnnData from exported CSVs."""
    obs  = pd.read_csv(f"{data_dir}/{name}_obs.csv",  index_col=0)
    pca  = pd.read_csv(f"{data_dir}/{name}_pca.csv",  index_col=0)
    umap = pd.read_csv(f"{data_dir}/{name}_umap.csv", index_col=0)

    adata = ad.AnnData(
        X   = sp.csr_matrix((len(obs), 1)),   # dummy; PAGA only needs the graph
        obs = obs
    )
    adata.obsm["X_pca"]  = pca.values.astype("float32")
    adata.obsm["X_umap"] = umap.values.astype("float32")

    full_path = f"{data_dir}/{name}_umap_full.csv"
    if os.path.exists(full_path):
        umap_full = pd.read_csv(full_path, index_col=0)
        adata.obsm["X_umap_full"] = umap_full.values.astype("float32")

    adata.obs[CLUS_COL] = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].astype(str).astype("category")
    return adata


def run_paga(adata, cluster_col=CLUS_COL, n_neighbors=N_NEIGH):
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep="X_pca", n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
                    random_state=42)
    sc.tl.paga(adata, groups=cluster_col)
    return adata


def cluster_centroids(adata, umap_key="X_umap"):
    """Return DataFrame of cluster centroid UMAP coordinates."""
    umap     = adata.obsm[umap_key]
    clusters = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].values
    cats     = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    coords   = np.array([umap[clusters == c].mean(axis=0) for c in cats])
    return pd.DataFrame(coords, index=cats, columns=["x", "y"])


def plot_paga_on_ax(adata, ax, umap_key="X_umap",
                    bg_umap=None, title="",
                    threshold=THRESHOLD, node_size_max=400,
                    edge_color="steelblue"):
    """Draw PAGA graph overlaid on UMAP scatter.

    bg_umap : (n, 2) array for the grey background; defaults to adata.obsm[umap_key].
    """
    clusters = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].values
    cats     = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    conn     = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    umap_bg  = adata.obsm[umap_key] if bg_umap is None else bg_umap
    cents    = cluster_centroids(adata, umap_key)

    sizes = np.array([np.sum(clusters == c) for c in cats], dtype=float)

    # Grey background
    ax.scatter(umap_bg[:, 0], umap_bg[:, 1],
               c="#e0e0e0", s=0.4, alpha=0.5, linewidths=0, rasterized=True)

    # Edges
    for i in range(len(cats)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(cats)):
            w = conn[i, j]
            if w > threshold:
                ax.plot([cents.iloc[i]["x"], cents.iloc[j]["x"]],
                        [cents.iloc[i]["y"], cents.iloc[j]["y"]],
                        lw=w * 6, color=edge_color, alpha=0.75,
                        solid_capstyle="round", zorder=2)

    # Nodes — tab20 colours, area ∝ sqrt(n_cells)
    node_s = (np.sqrt(sizes) / np.sqrt(sizes).max()) * node_size_max
    cmap   = plt.cm.get_cmap("tab20", len(cats))
    for k, (c, s) in enumerate(zip(cats, node_s)):
        ax.scatter(cents.loc[c, "x"], cents.loc[c, "y"],
                   s=s, color=cmap(k), edgecolors="white",
                   linewidths=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax.annotate(str(c), (cents.loc[c, "x"], cents.loc[c, "y"]),
                    fontsize=6, ha="center", va="center",
                    fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=4)

    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=4)
    ax.axis("off")
```

---

# 1  Load & compute PAGA

```{python load-and-run}
adata_wt     = load_adata("wt")
adata_mchneg = load_adata("mchneg")
adata_mchpos = load_adata("mchpos")

# Full-cohort background UMAP (grey backdrop for all condition plots)
bg_umap_arr = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_DIR}/bg_umap.csv", index_col=0).values.astype("float32")

# Drop excluded clusters before any graph computation
for adata in [adata_wt, adata_mchneg, adata_mchpos]:
    keep = ~adata.obs[CLUS_COL].isin(EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS)
    adata._inplace_subset_obs(keep)
    adata.obs[CLUS_COL] = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.remove_unused_categories()

print("Running PAGA — WT ...")
adata_wt     = run_paga(adata_wt)

print("Running PAGA — mCh− ...")
adata_mchneg = run_paga(adata_mchneg)

print("Running PAGA — mCh+ ...")
adata_mchpos = run_paga(adata_mchpos)

print("Done.")
for name, adata in [("WT", adata_wt), ("mCh−", adata_mchneg), ("mCh+", adata_mchpos)]:
    conn = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"]
    above = (conn > THRESHOLD).nnz // 2
    print(f"  {name:6s} — {adata.n_obs:5d} cells, "
          f"{len(adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories):2d} clusters, "
          f"{above} PAGA edges (threshold {THRESHOLD})")
```

```{python plot-own-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
plot_paga_on_ax(adata_mchneg, axes[1], umap_key="X_umap", title="mCh− (own UMAP)")
```

# 4  Side-by-side on a shared canvas

All three overlaid on the full-cohort background (all cells grey), drawn on three axes sharing the same coordinate range.

```{python plot-shared-canvas, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
def axis_limits(umap_arr, pad=0.5):
    return (umap_arr[:, 0].min() - pad, umap_arr[:, 0].max() + pad,
            umap_arr[:, 1].min() - pad, umap_arr[:, 1].max() + pad)

xlim = axis_limits(bg_umap_arr)[:2]
ylim = axis_limits(bg_umap_arr)[2:]

datasets = [
    (adata_wt,     "X_umap_full", "WT",   "#888888"),
    (adata_mchneg, "X_umap_full", "mCh−", "#2a9d8f"),
    (adata_mchpos, "X_umap_full", "mCh+", "#e76f51"),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))

for ax, (adata, umap_k, title, ecol) in zip(axes, datasets):
    # Grey full-cohort background
    ax.scatter(bg_umap_arr[:, 0], bg_umap_arr[:, 1],
               c="#e0e0e0", s=0.3, alpha=0.4, linewidths=0, rasterized=True)

    conn  = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    cats  = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    cents = cluster_centroids(adata, umap_k)
    clusters = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].values
    sizes = np.array([np.sum(clusters == c) for c in cats], dtype=float)

    for i in range(len(cats)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(cats)):
            w = conn[i, j]
            if w > THRESHOLD:
                ax.plot([cents.iloc[i]["x"], cents.iloc[j]["x"]],
                        [cents.iloc[i]["y"], cents.iloc[j]["y"]],
                        lw=w * 6, color=ecol, alpha=0.75,
                        solid_capstyle="round", zorder=2)

    node_s = (np.sqrt(sizes) / np.sqrt(sizes).max()) * 350
    cmap   = plt.cm.get_cmap("tab20", len(cats))
    for k, c in enumerate(cats):
        ax.scatter(cents.loc[c, "x"], cents.loc[c, "y"],
                   s=node_s[k], color=cmap(k),
                   edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax.annotate(str(c), (cents.loc[c, "x"], cents.loc[c, "y"]),
                    fontsize=6, ha="center", va="center",
                    fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=4)

    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)
    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
    ax.axis("off")

fig.suptitle("PAGA on shared full-cohort canvas (grey = all cells)",
             fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.01)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# 5  PAGA connectivity matrices

Inter-cluster connectivity weights (PAGA score) for each dataset.

```{python connectivity-heatmaps, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
def paga_conn_df(adata):
    cats = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    mat  = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    df   = pd.DataFrame(mat, index=cats, columns=cats)
    cats_sorted = sorted(cats, key=lambda x: int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)
    return df.loc[cats_sorted, cats_sorted]

datasets_hm = [
    (adata_wt,     "WT"),
    (adata_mchneg, "mCh−"),
    (adata_mchpos, "mCh+"),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))

for ax, (adata, title) in zip(axes, datasets_hm):
    df = paga_conn_df(adata)
    sns.heatmap(df, ax=ax, cmap="Blues", vmin=0, vmax=1,
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor="#f0f0f0",
                xticklabels=True, yticklabels=True,
                cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.7, "label": "connectivity"})
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=6)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=7)

fig.suptitle("PAGA cluster connectivity matrices",
             fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# 6  Binary connectivity heatmaps

A pair of clusters is marked **1** if their PAGA connectivity weight exceeds the
threshold (`THRESHOLD = 0.15`), otherwise **0**.

## 6.1  Symmetric — all clusters

```{python binary-hm-symmetric, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
def binary_conn_df(adata, threshold=THRESHOLD):
    cats = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    mat  = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    df   = pd.DataFrame((mat > threshold).astype(int), index=cats, columns=cats)
    cats_sorted = sorted(cats, key=lambda x: int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)
    return df.loc[cats_sorted, cats_sorted]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))

for ax, (adata, title) in zip(axes, datasets_hm):
    df = binary_conn_df(adata)
    sns.heatmap(df, ax=ax, cmap=["#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"], vmin=0, vmax=1,
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor="#e0e0e0",
                xticklabels=True, yticklabels=True,
                cbar=False)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=6)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=7)

fig.suptitle(f"Binary PAGA connectivity (threshold {THRESHOLD}) — all clusters",
             fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 6.2  Asymmetric — clusters 5, 21, 2 as columns

```{python binary-hm-asymmetric, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
COL_CLUSTERS = ["5", "21", "2"]

def binary_conn_asym(adata, col_clusters, threshold=THRESHOLD):
    cats     = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    mat      = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    df_full  = pd.DataFrame((mat > threshold).astype(int), index=cats, columns=cats)
    rows_sorted = sorted(cats, key=lambda x: int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)
    cols_valid  = [c for c in col_clusters if c in df_full.columns]
    return df_full.loc[rows_sorted, cols_valid]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(9, 9))

for ax, (adata, title) in zip(axes, datasets_hm):
    df = binary_conn_asym(adata, COL_CLUSTERS)
    sns.heatmap(df, ax=ax, cmap=["#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"], vmin=0, vmax=1,
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor="#e0e0e0",
                xticklabels=True, yticklabels=True,
                cbar=False)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=6)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=7)

fig.suptitle(f"Binary PAGA connectivity — columns: {', '.join(COL_CLUSTERS)}",
             fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.01)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# 7  Connectivity matrix subtraction

Pairwise differences highlight rewiring between conditions.
Positive (red) = stronger in the first condition; negative (blue) = stronger in the second.

```{python conn-diff-helpers}
def aligned_conn_df(adata):
    """Connectivity matrix with a globally-aligned cluster index."""
    cats = adata.obs[CLUS_COL].cat.categories.tolist()
    mat  = adata.uns["paga"]["connectivities"].toarray()
    return pd.DataFrame(mat, index=cats, columns=cats)

def subtract_conn(df_a, df_b, label_a, label_b):
    """Align two connectivity DataFrames on the union of clusters, subtract."""
    all_cats = sorted(
        set(df_a.index) | set(df_b.index),
        key=lambda x: int(x) if x.isdigit() else x
    )
    a = df_a.reindex(index=all_cats, columns=all_cats, fill_value=0.0)
    b = df_b.reindex(index=all_cats, columns=all_cats, fill_value=0.0)
    diff = a - b
    diff.attrs["label"] = f"{label_a} − {label_b}"
    return diff

def plot_diff_heatmap(diff_df, ax, vabs=0.5):
    sns.heatmap(diff_df, ax=ax, cmap="RdBu_r",
                vmin=-vabs, vmax=vabs, center=0,
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor="#f0f0f0",
                xticklabels=True, yticklabels=True,
                cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.7, "label": "Δ connectivity"})
    ax.set_title(diff_df.attrs.get("label", ""), fontsize=11,
                 fontweight="bold", pad=6)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=7)
```

```{python conn-diff-plot, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
df_wt  = aligned_conn_df(adata_wt)
df_neg = aligned_conn_df(adata_mchneg)
df_pos = aligned_conn_df(adata_mchpos)

contrasts = [
    subtract_conn(df_pos, df_wt,  "mCh+", "WT"),
    subtract_conn(df_pos, df_neg, "mCh+", "mCh−"),
    subtract_conn(df_neg, df_wt,  "mCh−", "WT"),
]

# Use a shared colour scale across all three panels
vabs = max(abs(d.values).max() for d in contrasts)
vabs = round(min(vabs, 1.0), 2)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))
for ax, diff in zip(axes, contrasts):
    plot_diff_heatmap(diff, ax, vabs=vabs)

fig.suptitle(f"PAGA connectivity differences (colour scale ±{vabs})",
             fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# 8  Strong connections table

Edges above threshold, sorted by connectivity weight.

```{python conn-table}
rows = []
for label, adata in [("WT", adata_wt), ("mCh-", adata_mchneg), ("mCh+", adata_mchpos)]:
    df   = paga_conn_df(adata)
    cats = df.index.tolist()
    for i, c1 in enumerate(cats):
        for j, c2 in enumerate(cats):
            if j <= i:
                continue
            w = df.loc[c1, c2]
            if w > THRESHOLD:
                rows.append({"dataset": label, "cluster_A": c1,
                             "cluster_B": c2, "connectivity": round(w, 3)})

conn_tbl = (pd.DataFrame(rows)
              .sort_values(["dataset", "connectivity"], ascending=[True, False])
              .reset_index(drop=True))
print(conn_tbl.to_string(index=False))
```
